depiction.primary_object: outlined head and shoulders person silhouette
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: single person avatar icon crossed out by a diagonal line

readings.meaning: block, ban, or unfollow a person or contact
delete, deactivate, or close a user account
remove a member, guest, or user access
anonymous, private, or unassigned user state

ambiguity: At very small sizes the cut head circle and shoulder arch can briefly look like a crossed-out coat hanger or lock.

modifier_semantics.meaning: remove, disable, block, or negate the person or account

task_intents: unfollow noisy accounts on social media
opt out of public profile listing

reasoning: A clear person avatar crossed out by a diagonal slash universally signifies blocking a user, removing a member, or deleting an account. It fits concrete tasks across digital privacy, offboarding, and social management, though at tiny sizes the sliced shoulder arch slightly resembles a coat hanger.
